about_item: Faux leather reversible design : The two-sided design dog bed features ultra soft cozy flannel with a reverse side of durable wipeable anti-scratch anti-slip faux leather, which keeps your fur baby cooling in the summer and warm in the winter. The flat dog mattress design provides dogs and cats plenty of room to sleep or stretch out.

Orthopedic support: Vonabem orthopedic dog bed is filled with high-density egg crate foam. It provides sufficient support for the spine, helps release joint pressure, alleviates muscle pain and promotes deep sleep, which is a great choice for elderly dogs or pets with discomfort.

Easy care removable cover: Washable dog bed with removable cover, the cover with L-shaped hidden zipper can be easily removed and cleaned. Simply take off the dog bed cover, machine wash and tumble dry with low heat.

Waterproof liner: Dog bed Cover inside layer features waterproof design that prevents urine leakage. It protects the foam from accidents or any liquid penetration, Which can promote better rest and sleep for pets

Size & occasions: Currently available in 6 sizes. Large dog bed 35x22x3" for dogs up to 50lbs, 36 inch dog crate bed is suitable for breeds including Inu Shiba, Brittany, Bulldog, English Springer Spaniel etc. Being lightweight and easy to carry, the dog cooling bed can be placed in kennels, in your car boot, indoor or Outdoor,or anywhere you want it to be.

authors_reviews.title: Good quality, reasonable price
authors_reviews.text: Our dog loves this bed! He’s a senior with arthritis and has developed cancer in his leg, so I wanted to get him something comfortable that could easily be moved around the house. He has his own love seat but we had to remove the cushion because he was tempted to dig the stuffing out. So, I measured before ordering and this bed was nearly perfect for putting on his little couch and it’s resistant to being torn into. It’s a good material that’s both strong and comfortable. Our dog really enjoys the fleece-like side. But there’s a leathery-like side for when it’s hot, but I also like that it’s got that leathery bottom because dust doesn’t stick to it so much.When it arrives it’s sealed so you have to let it expand like memory foam. The cover fits snuggly and I found it to be easier to put on with and extra hand to help. I bought an extra cover but haven’t needed it. Our dog likes this one so much and it’s washable.I highly recommend this bed. Not only was it a very reasonable price for the size but I don’t see any flaws in the quality at this time.Our dog is a bully/lab mix and I got him the 35”x22” and while it’s not a huge bed, it’s definitely roomy enough for him.
authors_reviews.author: Cammie S.

authors_reviews.title: Great for your all fur babies!!💕
authors_reviews.text: I just received this today for my 55 pound dog. She loves it!! I didn't think that she would even like the idea of sleeping on this, because she is an outside dog but since the temperatures are cold at night, I bring her in and put her in her crate for the night. She was sleeping with some sheets I no longer use and was just fine with them. But, I felt like I wanted to give her something special, her own comfy bed that fits perfectly into her crate. She is definitely enjoying her new bed tonight. What I love most about this dog bed or can be used for any fur babies, is that it zips halfway down the side and up top so you can put the foam insert in and I will say it was a little difficult to get it in there, but I had help so not really a issue lol It is very high quality, And I don't worry that she will be scratching through this or ripping it with her nails, as it feels thick enough on the inside and outside. I also love that it has two sides on the zipper cover, one is a fuzzy side like a velvety feel to the touch to keep her warm and just feel calm, and in the summer months when it gets too hot outside, I let her in to cool off a little bit because she does not like getting in water whatsoever, so the other side is a leather type finish feel but cooling. The cover is also washable and it did not have a smell to it when I bought it, so I just put it on there first thing. I probably should have washed it first but I was excited for her to try it out... 🤷‍♀️ The dog crate that she is in is a 46" x 28" , so I was afraid that it might not fit in there but it completely covers the entire bottom of the crate so she can't move it around or dig at it from the side really so that's a plus as well. I could have downsized to the next size down for her size, but I did get the XXL just because it was just a few inches off and I thought well if it doesn't fit ,then I will return it and get the next size down but I'm glad that I got this It doesn't bundle up on the side of the crate or anything like that, due to it being a little bigger. I would definitely recommend this to anyone wanting all the benefits and comfort I feel, that it has all together, for their dog or other animal's. Since she has been laying on it for quite a while now, And of course it's too early to tell, but I don't see any issues of it causing any shape issues. I usually don't post reviews because, I usually don't have the time but I feel like from all the positive reviews that I read on here, I wanted to do a review for others and maybe looking for a good high quality bed for their dogs. I looked at a lot of different places for washable high quality comfort beds for my dog for a good price and I was torn between this one and another one but I'm glad that I got this one and wouldn't second guess it. I hope this helps other's, that are looking for something high quality and for a great price!! ❤️❤️❤️

authors_reviews.title: Pretty good thickness! 36”27” Size
authors_reviews.text: I’ve been wanting to get my boy a dog bed for a while but i knew bigger dogs beds were pricey. He sleeps with me anyway so i didn’t wanna waste money on a dog bed that he doesn’t use. Since he’s a bed hogger i sprawl out and he goes and lies on the floor next to me, so i decided to look. I’m glad i picked this one! It is super comfy and great quality foam! My brother even fell asleep on it as shown in the picture lol. I wanted an affordable but good quality thick dog bed. My bed has memory foam so i think that’s why he favors my bed out of everyone else in my house besides the fact he’s attached to my hip. I found this one and people said it was true to what is shown and described. Some beds looked thick but once reading the reviews and seeing pictures they weren’t. The hardest part was deciding what size to get him. He’s an 100 lb rottie. I measured him when he was laying on the couch and i got 31”. He was curled up though so i ended up getting a size too small. He makes it work though! When i first unpacked it i was a little nervous cause the foam had a thick bump from where it was bent in the packaging. It did fix itself though. I love how it has the two different sides. The soft side is a nice quality and the water proof side did feel pretty cooling for the summer, which he struggles with due to his thick black coat. At first look when trying to get him to try it out he smelled it and layed right beside it😂 typical rottie behavior. But that night he did some more exploring and laid on it. I think he just needed his special blanket on it. I recommend getting one for your fur baby, just get the right size! It’s affordable and well made! Can’t think of anything better than that :)
authors_reviews.author: Brianna
